name: Convex-Treelike Partial Cubes
summary: Finite partial cubes obtained recursively by peripheral expansions whose contraction base and duplicated isometric site both satisfy the same rule.
comments: This is Polat’s finite convex-treelike class. The recursion has two children at every peripheral expansion: both the contraction base and the duplicated site must recur. It is therefore smaller than the standard sequential tree-like class.
